goal: Build RelayForge: event delivery via Kubernetes Jobs (Python 3.12 app 5 modes, Helm v2 chart, k3d 1 server+2 agents + OCI registry, 16 evidence scenarios, docs, verify.py, unit+chart tests)
acceptance: helm/RELAYFORGE_TASK.md all sections; evidence/summary.txt; PASS verify.py
scope: relayforge/ dir at repo root; ignore leftover k8s/ (old lab)

decisions.stack: FastAPI+uvicorn workers=1, kubernetes python client (pool+timeout+bounded retries, no retry on 403, Retry-After on 429), prometheus_client
decisions.attempts: JobStatus.attempts (NOT pod count; podFailurePolicy deletes failed pods)
decisions.job_name: rf-<release>-<sha256(idemkey) hex[:20]>; FAIL FAST if name>63 (never truncate hash); max release len 39
decisions.signing: HMAC-SHA256 ts\n delivery_id\n body; ts RFC3339 UTC; sink skew +-5min
decisions.backpressure: in-memory counter, seeded+resynced via scoped namespaced Job list (label selector instance+component), non-terminal only; readyz gates on first resync; per-key lock map with TTL eviction; workers=1
decisions.cn_policy: k3s default flannel ENFORCES NetworkPolicy (verified empirically 2026-09-03); no extra CNI
decisions.worker_req: env vars destination_url/event_type/payload(canonical json)/delivery_id; K8s only store
decisions.cleanup_timing: scale-to-0 wait > api terminationGrace; activeDeadlineSeconds ~60% of uninstall timeout
